name: event-registration-app
description: Event Registration App - FastAPI backend with HTML frontend

scripts.start: cd backend && python3 -m gunicorn main:app -w 2 --worker-class uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker --bind 0.0.0.0:8000

comments: Note: This project is now Python-only with FastAPI + gunicorn.
Node.js is only used to invoke npm start, which runs: gunicorn backend.main:app
Frontend is served as static HTML by FastAPI.
